rows.copying-an-animated-land-skips-the-entry: CR 707.9f: Moritte should be offered the choice to enter as a copy of the Forest; the copy is a noncreature land (the Rude Awakening animation is not copiable), so the copy exception should add neither two +1/+1 counters nor changeling. Observed: no copy choice was offered, Moritte entered as its printed 0/0 with changeling, and died to state-based actions.
